items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In fact, we ended up in a jam session, me and Eric, playing Cherokee.

ctx.x: When I saw Gerald – I knew Gerald pretty good, because I met Gerald when I first went out there. I never did – the t.v. show that I was doing, Dress Blues, a lot of singers and some musicians did that show. It was one of those freebee things. I’m sure at one time something – Gerald played – he’s a trumpet player – he played with somebody who did that show. It might have been Chico Hamilton, because I know when Chico Hamilton did the show, Eric Dolphy was playing alto with him. In fact, we ended up in a jam…
